_about: Manual review of every disagreement between Checkov and the detector. action: flip = Checkov label is wrong and is replaced; exclude = label depends on operator input and is removed from the adjudicated set. Raw Checkov results are always reported alongside.

items.reason: Ingress is protocol=icmp only. ICMP has no TCP port 22, so SSH is not reachable. Checkov false positive.
Ingress is protocol=icmp only, so TCP 3389 is not reachable. Checkov false positive.
protocol=-1 from 0.0.0.0/0 allows every protocol and port including TCP 22 (the extra self=true does not narrow it). Checkov false negative.
protocol=-1 from 0.0.0.0/0 includes TCP 3389. Checkov false negative.
protocol=-1 from 0.0.0.0/0 is all traffic. Checkov CKV_AWS_277 only matches port -1, missing from_port=0/to_port=0 with protocol -1.
Same as above: protocol=-1 from 0.0.0.0/0. Checkov even flags this group for SSH (CKV_AWS_24) but not for all ports, which is inconsistent.
versioning.enabled = var.no_versioning ? false : true and no_versioning defaults to false, so versioning is ON. Checkov did not resolve the conditional.

CloudGoat security groups take cidr_blocks = var.cg_whitelist, documented as 'User's public IP address(es)' with no default. Exposure depends on what the operator types, so the true label is undefined. Every SSH/RDP/all-ports label on those groups is excluded.
